name: suncalc-desktop
description: A web application that displays real-time sun and moon information using vanilla JavaScript Custom Elements.

scripts.neutralino:prebuild: cp index.html *.js resources/ && mkdir -p resources/neutralino && cp neutralino/main.js resources/neutralino/main.js
scripts.neutralino:dev: npx @neutralinojs/neu update && npm run neutralino:prebuild && npx @neutralinojs/neu run
scripts.neutralino:build: npx @neutralinojs/neu update && npm run neutralino:prebuild && npx @neutralinojs/neu build --release && mkdir -p dist/SunCalc/SunCalc.app/Contents/MacOS && cp dist/SunCalc/SunCalc-mac_arm64 dist/SunCalc/SunCalc.app/Contents/MacOS/SunCalc && cp dist/SunCalc/resources.neu dist/SunCalc/SunCalc.app/Contents/MacOS/ && chmod +x dist/SunCalc/SunCalc.app/Contents/MacOS/SunCalc && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/SunCalc/SunCalc.app
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push && git push --tags
